text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product image, pure white background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, no person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire object fully visible. Black fitted fine-knit floor-length dress with long sleeves and small waist opening, black furry buckled shoes.
original_prompt: Edit this wardrobe product image: Remove the bulky separate knitted scarf wrapped around the neck completely. Leave a plain empty simple round neckline on the same fitted black long-sleeve dress. Keep every other garment and the shoes unchanged. No person, body parts, skin, visible mannequin, additional accessories or text. Pure white background, portrait 2:3, fully uncropped.
